component.name: Omnix
component.summary: Edit home video and DJI Osmo 360 footage

description.p: Omnix plays and edits 360° video from the DJI Osmo 360. It reads the camera's .OSV files directly, stitches the two lenses with DJI's own calibration, keeps the horizon level from the camera's motion data, and lets you look around, cut clips together, move the view with keyframes and export a finished video.

ul.li: Real-time playback with free look, perspective, little planet and equirect views
Stabilisation: level horizon, fixed heading or world lock, with rolling-shutter correction
A timeline of cuts with keyframed camera moves, following the selfie stick or a coloured subject
Sound lanes for music, effects and voice: volume lines, fades, cleaned voices, ducking under talk, loudness to a target
Effects, transitions, titles and pictures, with automation curves; framing ordinary videos too
Export to MP4 or to DaVinci Resolve, as one video or a file per cut

description.p: Omnix grew from rOsmo360 by Vibing with Ravelund (MIT OR Apache-2.0), whose stitching and player it builds on.
